content.short: Society of highly sophisticated crypto apes that help each other find opportunities, create new ventures, and most importantly have fun.
content.description:
Our society will be two fold. The first aspect is a society of highly sophisticated crypto apes that help each other find opportunities, create new ventures, work together to improve the overall ADA ecosystem, and most importantly have fun.

The second aspect, that we are revealing for the first time today, is a Utility for the collection. We will be launching an NFT escrow tool. This will allow you trade your NFTs with other users. For example, say have you an extra Yummi and want to trade with somebody for a Goat. You simply create a trade, approve it on both sides, and it’ll execute! No marketplace needed. We’re in the process of finalizing our development team, and will launch this in beta for free once it is ready. Eventually we will create a native token that will need to be used in small amounts to execute each trade.

The amazing part of all of this is the ADApes get to be involved. Apes will receive token airdrops which they can either use to trade or sell, making this an awesome passive income opportunity that you can enjoy while being part of our awesome community.
